entry.title: RaffoSynth 1.3.0
entry.summary: RaffoSynth: a Minimoog-style mono synth with four oscillators and a ladder filter. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force. entry.title: RaffoSynth 1.2.0
entry.summary: RaffoSynth: a Minimoog-style mono synth with four oscillators and a ladder filter. ## What's new in 1.2.0 - **New name: RaffoSynth** (was Moog), the name of the open-source synth it comes from, so its name isn't another company's. It shows as **[SYN] RaffoSynth** in the plugin browser.
